title: The QC Module
topic: Modules: import, from, as, and the standard library
briefing: Good news: your Day 9 sorting rules got packaged into a module called cpu_tools, so every floor can import them. Better news: Python comes with a whole toolbox of modules already. Use them to run today's quality-control audit, and the CPU floor is done!
hints: import math lets you use math.ceil(...), which rounds UP. from factory.cpu_tools import grade brings in just the grade function. import statistics as stats lets you write stats.mean(...).
random.choice(batch) picks one random chip. To grade every chip, start with grades = [] and loop: for cpu in batch: grades.append(grade(cpu)).

import math, import random, import statistics as stats, from factory.cpu_tools import grade / boxes = math.ceil(len(batch) / 12) / audit = random.choice(batch) / clocks = [] then append each cpu["clock_ghz"] / avg_clock = stats.mean(clocks) / grades = [] then append grade(cpu) for each cpu
bonus: Try import string and print string.ascii_uppercase. Then use random.randint(1, 6) to roll a dice ten times.
